summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage TechBio company listed on Nasdaq (EVAX), furnished a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026 carrying its press release titled 'Evaxion announces business update and second quarter 2026 financial results.' The disclosure covers routine quarterly operational and financial reporting: three-year EVX-01 data to be presented at ESMO 2026, new EVX-04 AML and EVX-05 glioblastoma data, CMV candidate EVX-V1 progress, a Prix Galien UK award, and unchanged cash runway into the second half of 2027. No transaction, shareholder solicitation, or structural event is stated.
